subject: Multi-reseller cohort onboarding & escalation plan for Channel CPPO
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-24T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Multi-reseller cohort onboarding & escalation plan for Channel CPPO

Ben/Vanessa —

Quick note to kick off the multi-reseller cohort for the upcoming Channel Partner Private Offer (CPPO) wave. CloudResell and ResellCo are the two resellers AWS wants us to run as the pilot group. AWS PM has asked for a simple operational runbook plus an escalation ladder that covers: entitlement mapping, invoice routing, and a minimal evidence packet for the marketplace listing.

Ask: can you both confirm the attached CPPO_Deal_Matrix.xlsx fields (billing entity, SKU mapping, entitlement windows) by EOD Thursday? I sketched an initial plan in the spreadsheet; highlights below:
- Week 0 (this week): legal & billing alignment, collect reseller PO template
- Week 1: entitlement provisioning + CPPO activation test (one sandbox subscriber each)
- Week 2: go-live ramp + co-sell enablement activities

Vanessa — please include the reseller contact list and your recommended escalation contacts in the same sheet.
Ben — internally we should pre-stage a fallback model variant for low-priority traffic; Soojin can you confirm if we can push a quantized instance into the Dedicated pool for demo usage?

I attached the deal matrix and a SOW draft to help procurement.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Channel GTM, Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: CPPO_Deal_Matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 78KB)
Attachment: SOW_draft_v3.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

From: Susan Park <susan@cloudresell.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Ken Lee <ken.lee@resellco.com>, AWS PM <pm_aws@amazon.com>
Date: 2028-05-25T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Multi-reseller cohort onboarding & escalation plan for Channel CPPO

Thanks Irene — Susan here. We reviewed the CPPO_Deal_Matrix and have a few clarifying questions before we confirm: 

1) Billing entity: CloudResell will need the marketplace SKU to map to our main payor (CloudResell LLC) but the invoice routing must split to two cost centers for internal chargebacks. Can you annotate the matrix with a split-percent field?

2) Evidence pack: our security/compliance team wants a short doc that lists what logs are retained and for how long (SOC2 + audit window). Can you point us to the template?

3) Sandbox provisioning: we can accept a demo subscriber on 6/05. Can you confirm the entitlement window duration so we can plan internal QA?

We can sign basic SOW edits once the split routing language is added. Ken (ResellCo) and I will compare notes on the evidence ask.

Best,
Susan
Director, Partnerships — CloudResell Inc
--
(Inline: highlighted row in CPPO_Deal_Matrix.xlsx)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Susan Park <susan@cloudresell.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, AWS PM <pm_aws@amazon.com>
Date: 2028-05-26T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Multi-reseller cohort onboarding & escalation plan for Channel CPPO

Susan — thanks for the questions, good catches. Quick responses inline: 

1) Billing split: yes — we can add a split-percent column in the CPPO_Deal_Matrix and generate a sample invoice routing YAML that shows the two cost centers. I'll update the spreadsheet and attach the example.

2) Evidence pack: we have a short SOC2 evidence checklist used for marketplace activations. Soojin + Security will prep a one-pager (logs retained, retention windows, access controls). Soojin — can you target EOD Friday for that one-pager?

3) Sandbox entitlement window: default demo subscriber window is 14 days; we can make that configurable per reseller on activation. For CloudResell's QA on 6/05 that works.

Action items I am taking:
- Update CPPO_Deal_Matrix.xlsx (add split-percent + sample invoice routing) — will attach v2
- Draft minimal evidence one-pager — Soojin to produce
- Schedule entitlement provisioning run with infra team for 6/04

Irene — will you own the SOW edits or do you want legal on copy?

Ben
Senior Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: CPPO_Deal_Matrix_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 82KB)

From: Ken Lee <ken.lee@resellco.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Susan Park <susan@cloudresell.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, AWS PM <pm_aws@amazon.com>
Date: 2028-05-30T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Multi-reseller cohort onboarding & escalation plan for Channel CPPO

Ben/Susan — quick note from ResellCo: the split-percent approach works for us but we need a short legal clause in the SOW that states Redwood will support invoice reconciliation within 30 days of activation. Also, our procurement requires a DocuSign-ready SOW with entity names spelled exactly as on our PO.

Can you add a one-paragraph escalation ladder (who to call for billing, entitlement, security) to the SOW and send back for signature? If legal needs to be looped, put them on the DocuSign CC.

Ken
Procurement Lead, ResellCo

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, AWS PM <pm_aws@amazon.com>
Date: 2028-06-01T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Multi-reseller cohort onboarding & escalation plan for Channel CPPO

All — thanks for the quick turn. Final update and next steps: 

1) Ben attached CPPO_Deal_Matrix_v2 with split-percent and sample invoice YAML. Vanessa, I added your reseller contact list and marked the primary escalation contact per reseller.

2) Soojin delivered the evidence one-pager and we've put it in the shared drive link: https://redwood.app/drive/rdw-cppo-0437. It lists log retention (90 days for token logs; 13 months for audit copies) and the security contact.

3) SOW edits: I have inserted a one-paragraph reconciliation and escalation ladder into SOW_draft_v3.pdf and exported a DocuSign-ready copy. Attaching the DocuSign link and sending to both CloudResell and ResellCo legal today.

4) Provisioning: infra scheduled entitlement run on 2028-06-04 for CloudResell and 2028-06-06 for ResellCo. Sandbox windows default to 14 days; CloudResell confirmed QA on 6/05.

Final asks: Susan/Ken — please confirm you received the DocuSign envelope and approve the SOW language by EOD 6/03 so we can hit the provisioning dates.

Thanks — will follow up with a short playbook for CS and a co-sell kickoff invite.

Irene
Head of Channel GTM, Redwood Inference
--
